patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with solid vibrant red backgrounds and clean white backgrounds create strong visual breaks and emphasize content.
Section headings are consistently large, bold, and uppercase sans-serif, providing clear hierarchy and a modern, impactful feel.
A high-contrast palette is dominated by a single vibrant red (#EB3300) used extensively for full-section backgrounds and calls to action, paired with white and black for text.
The hero image features a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text and button as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections and individual elements within them (like product cards and recipe images) reveal with a staggered fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background after the initial hero section is passed, while remaining sticky at the top.
Product and recipe displays are presented in clean, consistent grid layouts, often with a title, image, and brief description, maintaining visual order across the site.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that dynamically changes its size and background color based on scroll position, transitioning from transparent to a solid white backdrop.
Create a parallax scrolling effect for the hero image where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, giving a sense of depth.

Utilize a scroll-triggered animation library (like AOS) to reveal sections and individual content blocks with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the user's viewport, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, with an exceptionally oversized hero text, contrasted by smaller, lighter body and descriptive text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and image containers have very slight corner rounding, almost appearing sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical padding separates sections, and content within grids is well-spaced, contributing to a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and confident use of a single, vibrant red as a dominant brand color, applied in full-bleed sections to create powerful visual statements. This strong color blocking, combined with clean, modern typography and high-quality product photography, gives the brand an energetic and premium identity that stands out from typical e-commerce sites.
